searchText: I have a question on p2p gossip on beacon chain The beacon chain do not store execution payload right? So how do they gossip them? <vdWijden> They store it Do we use eth_ namespace Ah Would it not amplify history? <vdWijden> In the current spec, the execution payload is duplicated between the nodes <vdWijden> yes Ok, thank you <vdWijden> There have been ideas to store only one version, but that will probably not happen before the merge Ok, got it
